warnings: Ground-beam details (G-series) of S-13. Where a beam has two sections (support vs mid-span), main_bar.top is the support section and the mid-span count is in its note (same convention as house 165).
ø on the drawing = RB (spec section 6); stirrups 'ป-ø6mm.' are RB6.
Every S-sheet carries the boxed note 'เหล็กเสริมข้ออ้อยทั้งหมด ให้ใช้ชั้นคุณภาพ SD 40' — recorded as steel_grade on every deformed-bar member; round bars (ø) carry no printed grade.
